shortDescription: GitHub-style user profile overview view for a developer account.
fullDescription: Renders the user-profile-overview view in its default state with a GitHub dark profile layout, top repository search header, tab navigation for overview, repositories, projects, and packages, a profile sidebar with avatar, achievements, and organization details, plus a main column showing popular repositories and annual contribution activity. The view exposes state, selectedTab, and initialSearch props, and keeps the tab selection, repository filtering, and contribution year selection interactive with local state.
